page_title: VEN 1-2 PAR | Venezia v Parma 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' A cross from Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' A yellow card is awarded to Gabriel Charpentier (Parma).
88' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
87' The ball is out of play. Venezia win a corner kick.
85' Here is a change. Ridgeciano Haps is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia).
84' Antonio Candela goes off the pitch and Franco Carboni (Venezia) comes on.
84' Magnus Kofod Andersen (Venezia) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
79' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Francesco Zampano (Venezia). The linesman signals a throw-in for Venezia.
76' The percentage of ball possession is – 64:36.
73' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia will be replaced by John Yeboah (Venezia).
73' That's the end of the game for Dennis Man, who is replaced by Woyo Coulibaly (Parma).
73' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
71' Venezia are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
68' 1 - 2 Goal! Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
67' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Venezia comes to nothing.
65' That will be all from Valentin Mihaila who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma).
65' Here's the change. Giovanni Leoni leaves the pitch and Botond Balogh (Parma) comes on as a substitute.
65' Fabio Pecchia has decided to substitute Mandela Keita and he is replaced by Nahuel Estevez (Parma).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Magnus Kofod Andersen (Venezia) replaces Alfred Duncan.
63' A goal, which was scored by Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia), was disallowed due to offside.

61' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.

60' Parma slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
57' The resulting set piece from Parma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
57' A great run by Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Parma will have an opportunity.
56' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
55' The corner is swung in but Parma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
54' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Parma win a corner.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Venezia.
50' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Chiffi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
49' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
49' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball has crossed the sideline. Venezia are taking a throw-in.
48' Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Francesco Zampano (Venezia) comes onto the pitch for Mikael Egill Ellertsson.
46' Fabio Pecchia prepares a substitution. Adrian Benedyczak is replaced by Gabriel Charpentier (Parma).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his header from near the penalty spot low towards the left post is saved by the goalkeeper.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
43' Wonderful movement by Parma. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
41' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
39' The ball is cleared after Alfred Duncan (Venezia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

38' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.

36' Simon Sohm (Parma) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.

35' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Zion Suzuki leaps like a salmon to deny him.
33' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
31' A pass from Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) is intercepted by Zion Suzuki and the move breaks down.
30' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
29' Gaetano Oristanio almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
27' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
24' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
24' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.

23' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Venezia are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
21' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
19' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) takes the corner with a short pass.
17' 1 - 1 Emanuele Valeri (Parma) receives a quality pass, makes a yard for himself and smashes a jaw-dropping long-range shot into the bottom right corner. What a remarkable goal!
16' Parma quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
15' The linesman points to the corner flag, Parma are going to take it. Parma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
14' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) commits a foul during an attacking move.
13' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.

11' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Filip Stankovic sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner.
11' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) makes a slide tackle, but referee Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Parma.
9' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) works the corner short.
8' Dennis Man (Parma) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. Parma get a corner.

7' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is behind the touchline and Parma will take a throw-in.
5' 1 - 0 Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) latches onto a cross in the penalty area and fires the ball into the bottom right corner!
4' The foul by Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) was seen by Daniele Chiffi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
2' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Venezia will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Chiffi.
